responsibility: Crate package manifest and dependency declarations for soundcraft-time

io_concurrency: Zero runtime I/O; consumed by Cargo during resolution
license_status: Dual MIT / Apache-2.0 via workspace inheritance
clover_capability_relation: reference: dependency footprint is minimal and clean (serde + thiserror only)
limitations_and_evidence: Manifest only; pins rust-version 1.90. Evidence: Cargo.toml:1-19

responsibility: Crate root: defines absolute sample time (Samples = i64), SampleRate struct, Range struct, and TimeError enum
public_api_types: Types: Samples (i64), MAX_POSITION (1 << 40), TimeError enum, SampleRate struct, Range struct. Re-exports: TimeFormat, format_position, format_length, parse_position, GridScale, GridValue, NoteValue, TimecodeValue, FeetFramesValue, BarBeat, MeterEvent, TempoEvent, TempoMap, TICKS_PER_QUARTER, FrameRate, Timecode
callers_callees_deps: Callers: soundcraft-engine, soundcraft-mix. Callees: format, grid, tempo, timecode submodules
data_flow: Seconds <-> Samples arithmetic with rounding via to_samples()
state_mutation: Pure value types; zero mutable state
io_concurrency: Pure in-memory computation; Send + Sync total functions
error_undo: TimeError handles invalid sample rates, tempo <= 0, invalid meter. Saturated arithmetic prevents overflow on MAX_POSITION
serialization_versioning: SampleRate and Range derive serde Serialize/Deserialize
clover_capability_relation: adapt: Range and SampleRate conversion math can be adapted directly into Clover Motion timecode and audio sync services
limitations_and_evidence: SampleRate restricted to 8 kHz..=768 kHz. Evidence: src/lib.rs:1-155

responsibility: Formatting and parsing positions across the five Pro Tools timebases (Bars|Beats, Min:Secs, Timecode, Feet+Frames, Samples)
public_api_types: Enums: TimeFormat (BarsBeats, MinSecs, Timecode, FeetFrames, Samples). Functions: format_position, format_length, parse_position, TimeFormat::from_id, TimeFormat::label
callers_callees_deps: Callees: min_secs integer math, Timecode::from_samples, feet_frames, TempoMap::bar_beat_at_sample. Callers: UI rulers, transport counters, session displays
data_flow: Sample index (i64) -> TimeFormat string representation; parsed user string -> Sample index (i64)
state_mutation: Pure string formatting and parsing, no heap state mutation
error_undo: parse_position returns Result<Samples, TimeError>; propagates format parsing failures without panics
target_cfg_features: Total integer arithmetic: ms_total uses i128 to prevent float rounding off-by-one errors
clover_capability_relation: adapt: min_secs and format_position string conventions mirror Clover Motion Studio timecode formatting in src/utils/timecode.js
limitations_and_evidence: Feet+Frames assumes 35mm film (16 frames per foot). Evidence: src/format.rs:1-241

responsibility: SMPTE timecode (drop-frame & non-drop-frame) and 35mm Feet+Frames calculations
public_api_types: Enums: FrameRate (15 standards from 23.976 to 120 fps). Structs: Timecode (hours, minutes, seconds, frames, subframes). Functions: rational(), is_drop_frame(), nominal_fps(), from_samples(), to_samples(), from_frames(), to_frames(), format(), parse(), feet_frames()
callers_callees_deps: Callees: i128 rational arithmetic for exact frame counts. Callers: format.rs, grid.rs, video sync bridges
data_flow: Sample count at sample rate -> Total SMPTE frame index -> (H:M:S:F.subframe) components
error_undo: parse() returns Result<Timecode, TimeError>; drop frame checks skip frame numbers 0 and 1 at start of each minute except every tenth minute
serialization_versioning: FrameRate and Timecode derive serde Serialize/Deserialize
target_cfg_features: Handles 29.97 Drop and 59.94 Drop frames with exact SMPTE drop compensation
clover_capability_relation: reuse: FrameRate rational definitions and drop-frame compensation algorithms provide golden reference for Clover video timeline SMPTE accuracy
limitations_and_evidence: Supports up to 100 subframes (1/100th frame). Negative timecodes clamped with negative flag. Evidence: src/timecode.rs:1-309

responsibility: Musical tempo and meter maps converting between musical ticks (TICKS_PER_QUARTER = 960) and session sample indices
public_api_types: Constants: TICKS_PER_QUARTER = 960. Structs: TempoEvent (tick, bpm), MeterEvent (tick, numerator, denominator), BarBeat (bar, beat, tick), TempoMap (tempos, meters, elapsed lookup). Functions: set_tempo, set_meter, remove_tempo, remove_meter, ticks_to_samples, samples_to_ticks, bar_beat_at_tick, tick_at_bar_beat
callers_callees_deps: Callees: std::cmp, binary search on elapsed quarter-note minutes. Callers: format.rs, grid.rs, timeline ruler rendering
data_flow: Musical Bar|Beat|Tick -> Absolute Tick -> Elapsed time at piecewise constant BPM -> Sample index (i64)
state_mutation: TempoMap maintains internal Vec<f64> elapsed table rebuilt upon tempo insertions for O(log n) binary search lookups
io_concurrency: Zero I/O; CPU memory structures only
error_undo: Mutations validate bpm > 0 and valid meter denominators (must be power of 2, 1..=64). Removing initial events at tick 0 is rejected
serialization_versioning: Serde uses custom TempoMapData without the derived elapsed cache table, rebuilding elapsed during deserialization
target_cfg_features: Requires meter changes to snap to bar boundaries (invariant enforced in set_meter)
clover_capability_relation: reference: Clover Motion currently uses procedural tempo in Web Audio; TempoMap design provides architecture for multi-tempo musical motion graphic timelines
limitations_and_evidence: Does not support smooth linear/curved tempo ramps (only stepped piecewise tempo events). Evidence: src/tempo.rs:1-622

responsibility: Grid and Nudge scales, magnetic timeline snapping, and grid line generation across musical, timecode, min:secs, and sample units
public_api_types: Enums: NoteValue, GridScale, TimecodeValue, FeetFramesValue. Structs: GridValue (scale, note, min_secs_ms, tc, ff, samples). Functions: ticks(), snap_sample(), grid_lines_in_range(), next_grid_point(), prev_grid_point()
callers_callees_deps: Callees: TempoMap, Timecode, SampleRate. Callers: UI timeline timeline canvas grid drawing, mouse clip snapping
data_flow: Visible timeline sample range [start, end) -> Iterator of grid line sample indices with hierarchical subdivision ranks
state_mutation: Pure calculation from immutable GridValue and TempoMap parameters
error_undo: Safe clamping to Range boundaries; prevents infinite loops on sub-sample intervals
serialization_versioning: All grid enums and GridValue derive serde Serialize/Deserialize
target_cfg_features: Includes triplet and dotted subdivision modifiers for musical grids
clover_capability_relation: adapt: Timeline snapping and hierarchical grid line generator can directly enhance Clover Motion timeline snapping (TimelinePanel.jsx)
limitations_and_evidence: Grid generation is bounded by MAX_POSITION. Evidence: src/grid.rs:1-809
